hidden_state_location: state immediately before the task-specific query transition
decoder_scope: fit independently per task; one separator must cover all wait counts

classification.fixed_decoder: the fixed per-task separator is perfect across every case and wait count
classification.phase_rotated: fixed separator fails, but every wait-specific per-task separator is perfect
classification.phase_localized_loss: fixed separator fails, and wait-specific separators are perfect only for a proper subset of wait counts
classification.decoder_failure: no wait-specific separator is perfect at any wait count
